becomeBlurb: Apply as a tutor or mentor. You set your rate and hours; the 70/30 split is shown before you commit.
bookedBody: Payment confirmed on ejadah.com. Your tutor has been notified and the session is in My bookings.
cancelBody: Nothing was charged. Your place is not held — the price may change if you come back later.
careerSub: Four routes out of the same qualification. Pick one and see the whole path — cost, time and difficulty included.
careerTitle: Your degree opens more doors than you think
cmpEmptyBody: Tap + on up to three programmes in the list, then come back here.
connectSub: Three kinds of conversation. Pick by what you need, not by job title.
connectTitle: Time with someone who has already done it
consultingBlurb: Clinic and business advisory for owners and partners.
countriesBlurb: Exam, regulator, visa route and real costs for 23 countries.
coursesTitle: Learn from dentists who teach for a living
deadlinesBody: 32 more close within 60 days. Expired intakes are hidden until you ask for them.
disclaimer: Always confirm fees, visa rules and registration requirements with the relevant authority before committing money.
emptyBookBody: Sessions you book or cancel will show up in this tab.
emptyMastersBody: Try a broader specialty, or show expired intakes.
emptySavedBody: Tap the heart on any programme to keep it here with its deadline.
errBody: Your saved work is safe on this device. Try again in a moment.
forgotBody: Enter the email on your account and we'll send a reset link.
forgotSent: If that email is registered, a reset link is on its way. Check spam before asking us.
getBullet1: You bring the case — radiographs, notes, the bit that went wrong.
getBullet2: Screen share on your own CBCT and photos, recorded if you want it.
getBullet3: A written summary and next-case checklist within 24 hours.
instructorBio: Consultant endodontist, teaches microscope-assisted retreatment at Cairo University.
kingsBlurb: Nine sections: curriculum, requirements, application coaching, five funding routes, salary reality, Gulf and Egyptian recognition, London costs and the visa.
mediaNote: Tutors with a photo and intro video get 3× more bookings. The intro video is 2–3 minutes — introduce yourself and your teaching style.
mentoringBlurb: Dentists who already made the move — matched on route, not specialty.
namePlaceholder: As it appears on your degree
nextMentor: Talk to someone who did it
nextMentorSub: Mentors matched on this exact route.
nextProgrammesSub: Filtered to your specialty and destination.
nfcNote: Your public profile lives at ejadah.com/p/yasmine-hassan — anyone can open it from the QR or a tap, with no app required.
notesPlaceholder: Bring the case you want to discuss — radiographs help.
pNotifyWhy: Two a day maximum, never between 22:00 and 08:00 Cairo time, and you choose the categories.
pRegionSub: Pick as many as apply — it only shapes what we show you first.
paidBody: Payment confirmed on ejadah.com. Your access is active on this device.
partialBody: The rest of your feed is up to date.
payNote: Payments are completed securely on ejadah.com — the app never handles card details.
pickDept: Three departments in this release. Pick one to see its courses.
programmesBlurb: Filter by specialty, country, tuition, intake and deadline. Compare up to three.
publicPageNote: This page is public — a clinic or registrar can open it from the QR code without an Ejadah account.
pwRule: At least 8 characters with a letter and a number
q1: Do you want to keep treating patients?
q4sub: Be honest — the plan is built around these, not around what looks impressive.
recognitionBody: Egypt, UAE, Saudi Arabia and Qatar labels exist in the source data but their status was lost in extraction. We show nothing rather than guess.
recognitionNotice: Recognition status not yet verified per country
registerSub: Two minutes now saves you a month of guessing later.
reviewTimeline: We review applications within five working days and reply either way.
roadmapCtaBody: Answer five short questions and get a route built around your real budget and time — not around a Master's you never asked for.
roadmapFunnelBody: Five short questions. Your real budget and time are hard limits, and remote work from Egypt counts as a destination.
sourceMissing: No official source URL in this record — verify before applying.
splitNote: Every session shows the gross fee, the 30% platform fee and your 70% net. Payouts are processed on the website.
stubBody: This tab is next in the build order. The shell, tab bar and language switching are already wired.
tutorBio: Consultant endodontist at a Cairo referral practice, teaching microscope-assisted retreatment. Sessions run on real cases you bring — radiographs, working lengths and all.
tutoringBlurb: For students — TAs, lecturers and top grads teach a subject or a whole year, weekly or as exam prep.
tutorsSub: Matched to endodontics, your saved specialty.
verifyNote: Every certificate carries a public verification page a clinic or registrar can check without an account.
whatIfSub: Change one variable and the whole route recalculates.
